cues.text: In a lush, shadowed jungle, giant ferns and broad, red-tipped leaves frame a misty valley. A wide waterfall cascades down a rocky cliff into a calm, glowing green river.
Thick sunbeams pierce the dense canopy, illuminating the heavy mist. High above, a brilliant point of light drops from the sky.
The colony ship descends on a bright trail, crossing the sunbeams and sinking into the deep vegetation near the falls.

beats.note: Dark, silhouetted jungle foliage in the foreground, with red-tipped leaves and giant ferns. Midground shows a river and a waterfall cascading down a cliff. Background is misty.
Sunbeams are clearly visible shining down through the canopy into the mist.
A bright light appears in the sky, descending rapidly.
The light, leaving a trail, crosses the sunbeams and heads down behind the mist of the waterfall.
The light disappears into the jungle.
